name: Sartosa Exploration
summary: The exploration chart for the pirate island of Sartosa. The common currency is Cargo rather than wyrdstone; exploration and income are the rulebook's.
income_note: In Sartosa the warbands find Cargo, kept in crates, instead of wyrdstone; for exploring and selling it is treated exactly as wyrdstone. Once per Exploration phase you may open one Cargo you are not selling: subtract it from your total and roll D66 on the Cargo chart.

places.name: Hard Day's Work
places.rules: Good warbands may work the piers and receive 1D6 gc. Any Neutral, Pirate or Evil warband may instead steal a crate: choose a Hero and take an Initiative test. If he passes you gain 1 Cargo; if he fails he misses the next game.

places.name: Flotsam
places.rules: After searching the wreckage you find loot worth D6 gc. If you roll a 1 you also find a Rabbit's Foot.

places.name: Dropped Satchel
places.rules:
Roll a D6 to see what is in the bag:
1-2 D6 gc
3 Dagger
4 Axe
5 Sword
6 Toughened Leathers

places.name: Cast Away
places.rules: Your warband may add one Swabbie. Skaven or Araby warbands may instead sell him for 2D6 gc, and Chaos warbands may sacrifice him for +1 Experience.

places.name: Capsized Rowboat
places.rules:
Roll a D6:
1-2 Treasure Map
3-4 A purse with 2D6 gc
5-6 Jewelled sword and dagger. They can be kept or sold at twice the value of a normal sword and dagger; the usual selling price is half the actual cost, so the jewelled sword sells for 10 gc.

places.name: Loose Lips
places.rules: Next time you roll on the exploration chart, roll one more dice than usual and discard any one dice (with three Heroes, roll four dice and pick any three).

places.name: Grog!
places.rules: The leader must take a Leadership test. If he passes, the warband receives 4D6 gc for selling the rum. If he fails, all henchmen count as having drunk Grog for the next battle. Elves, Navy, Witch Hunters and Sisters pass the Leadership test automatically.

places.name: Smithy
places.rules:
Roll a D6:
1 Sword
2 Double-handed weapon
3 Flail
4 D3 halberds
5 Rapier
6 2D6 gc worth of metal

places.name: Prison Break
places.rules:
Any warband may immediately add 1 henchman worth up to 35 gc. This may start a new henchmen group, or, if you can afford to equip him, add a new henchman to any existing group with the same characteristics as the rest of the group, provided the henchman's default cost was not higher than 35 gc.
Any Pirate warband may instead gain 1D3 Swabbies.
Any warband may instead sell the freed convicts into slavery or back into custody for 3D6 gc in total.
Chaos and Dark Elf warbands may sacrifice them for D3 Experience, distributed amongst the Heroes as you see fit.

places.name: Port Shop
places.rules:
Roll 1D6:
1 1D3 Norlander Nets
2 1D6 Rope & Hooks (may be given to henchmen, provided you have enough for everyone in the group)
3 1D6 Boot Hooks
4 1D6 Toughened Leathers
5 Parrot
6 Compass

places.name: Pearl Diver
places.rules: The divers give you black pearls, which you can sell for 2D6 gc. If you roll double 1s the pearls are few, but you force the divers to lend you one of their boats: for one use only you may have a free rowboat in any game. After that game roll 1D6; on a 6 you may keep the boat.

places.name: Returning a Favour
places.rules: You gain the services of any one Hired Sword available to your warband for the next battle, free of charge. After the battle he departs, or you may keep paying his upkeep as normal. If you pick the Slayer Pirate (Mytokk), the Swashbuckler or any Hired Sword introduced in the Sartosa campaign, he also forgoes his first upkeep cost.

places.name: Gunsmith
places.rules:
Roll 1D6:
1 Blunderbuss
2 Brace of Pistols
3 Brace of Duelling Pistols
4 1D3 handguns
5 1D3 superior black powder
6 Any one pistol worth 35 gc or less

places.name: Estalian Mission
places.rules: Gain 3D6 gc. The warband also finds enough blessed metal to make D3 sets of Silver Bullets.

places.name: Houseboat
places.rules: Gain 2D6 gc and one Cargo. You may choose to open it immediately.

places.name: Araby Merchant
places.rules: During this Exploration phase you may roll three times on the Araby Merchant market lists of your choice, and may purchase any of the rolled items. As with the Araby Merchant, any item you buy fails on a roll of 1.

places.name: Dead Sea Monster
places.rules: Gain D6x10 gc. In addition your Leader causes Fear next game.

places.name: Cartographer
places.rules: At the start of the next game, 3 fighters may be placed anywhere on the battlefield at ground level.

places.name: Paymaster's Ship
places.rules: Gain D6x10 gc. Also, every opponent you faced this game must pay an additional 5 gc upkeep for each Hired Sword.

places.name: Captain's Quarters
places.rules: Gain 3D6 gc and the Captain's Log, which allows a warrior to learn an additional skill from the Pirate skill list as a skill advance.

places.name: Jewelsmith
places.rules:
Roll 1D6:
1-2 Quartz worth D6x5 gc
3-4 Amethyst worth 20 gc
5 Necklace worth 50 gc
6 Ruby worth D6x15 gc
You may decide not to sell the jewels and gain +1 when locating rare items instead.

places.name: Privateer Contract
places.rules: Gain 2D6x5 gc. You also gain +1 on rolls to convince Swabbies into becoming Crew.

places.name: Fruitful Isle
places.rules: Gain 1D3 Cargo. You may also gain 1D3 Parrots. If the Trained Monkey rules are in use, you may instead gain 1 Trained Monkey in place of the Parrots.

places.name: Fence
places.rules: Pick one Hero: after any game in which that Hero was not taken out of action, you may open one extra Cargo box in the Exploration phase.

places.name: Cursed Cove
places.rules: Choose a Hero, who takes a Leadership test. If he passes he finds D6 Cargo, any of which may be opened immediately. If he fails, roll a D6 after each game: on a natural 1 the Hero drops dead. Before you roll, you may choose not to enter the cave and leave with nothing.

places.name: Buried Treasure
places.rules:
A treasure chest. Roll a D6 for each of the following:
5D6x5 gc Auto
D3 crates of Cargo 4+
Whalebone Charm 5+
Suit of Ithilmar Armour 5+
D3 gems worth 10 gc each 4+
Elven Cloak 5+
Tome of Magic 5+
Magical Artefact 5+

places.name: Arms Smuggler
places.rules:
Roll 1D6:
1 Your pick of any pistol (or brace of pistols) worth up to 80 gc; you cannot mix and match
2 1 Swivel Gun (still only one per warband; Swivel Gun shot may be bought as normal)
3 1 Hochland Rifle
4 Brace of Double-Barrelled Pistols
5 Double-Barrelled Hunting Rifle
6 Double-Barrelled Blunderbuss

places.name: Naval Shipwreck
places.rules:
Roll a D6 for each of the following:
3D6x5 gc Auto
1D3 Swabbies (with 1 dagger each) Auto
1D6 Toughened Leathers Auto
Suit of Ithilmar Armour 4+
Treasure Map 5+
D3 Swords 4+
D3 Cat o' Nine Tails 5+
D3 Bucklers 3+
D3 Pistols 4+
Captain's Hat 3+

places.name: Tilean Backer
places.rules: Immediately gain 75 gc. From now on you may also re-roll one dice when you roll on the exploration chart.

places.name: Noble's Yacht
places.rules:
Roll 1D6:
1-2 D6x10 gc
3-4 D6 vials of Crimson Shade
5-6 Magical Artefact
